headline: Your private slice of the Adriatic awaits
primaryText:
We offer you Croatia that only a small percent sees.  🇭🇷

Your own private yacht, your own crew, your own retreat. 🌊 

Our luxury private charters are prepared according to your wishes, be it a new island each day, or a comfortable stay in your favorite spot — with just you and the people you choose.

Booking for 2027 in process — secure your dates soon. ⚓
whyItWorks: The opening line sells exclusivity, promising a Croatia most travelers never see, which appeals to buyers who want to feel set apart. The image is a calm, moody shot of a single yacht on empty water, showing the privacy and quiet the copy describes without needing to explain it. A soft deadline about 2027 dates adds gentle urgency for a high-consideration purchase, and the ad has been running since July, which suggests it is performing.
